_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for RCL retrospectives (retro/build_rcl.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time, US Eastern; EDGAR gives only the filing date before 2002). The builder uses the latest history vintage published by AS_OF, the prints published by AS_OF that report a fiscal year after that history (a Q4 print reports the year just ended and extends the history until the 10-K), the guides for the current fiscal year (each field from the latest guide that states it; a next-quarter guide while its quarter is unreported) and the latest declared dividend. Royal Caribbean's fiscal year is the calendar year. Each release guides the next quarter and the year: diluted EPS, capacity (APCD) and Net Yields in numbers (approximate figures and single points as published; 'Flat' is 0), from the Q1 2009 release also Net Yields on a constant dollar basis ('ny_cc'); Net Cruise Costs and fuel are shown and feed nothing. A print's values are derived from the raw figures of its release ('raw', thousands; APCD in days; the 2007 releases print their statements as images, so the figures are the same quarter's 10-Q, 'extra_sources'): Net Yields are total revenues less commissions, transportation and other and onboard and other expenses per APCD, Net Cruise Costs are total cruise operating expenses plus marketing, selling and administrative expenses less the same two lines, per APCD, each against the year-ago quarter in the same release; the builder re-derives them and checks them against the release's stated changes ('ny_stated_pct', 'ncc_stated_pct'). rule_t holds the annual values behind the engine's signal thresholds. Edit only to add newly published facts or fix a transcription error against the cited filing.

rule_t._doc: Rule T values behind the engine's signal thresholds (retro/README.md, 'RCL'): the decade of the FY2006 10-K, the vintage public on 2008-01-04, is 1997-2006. Each year-on-year change comes from the latest filing published by then that reports both years (the FY1998-FY2003 annual reports on Form 20-F, the FY2004-FY2006 10-Ks); 'raw' keeps the figures and 'from' the filing of each change, and retro/build_rcl.py re-derives every value. Net Yields and Net Cruise Costs per APCD are first stated for 2001 and 2002 (each 20-F's own percentage, the FY2002 20-F's 2001 Net Yields on the basis before the FY2003 20-F's reclassification of port costs) and derived from the 10-Ks' Net Revenues, Net Cruise Costs and APCD from 2003; no filing states either for an earlier year (the FY2000 20-F says net revenue per available lower berth for 2000 'was approximately the same as in 1999': words, no value). Occupancy changes in basis points from the stated percentages; the operating margin is operating income on total revenues.
